name: Model Methodology Documentation
description: Draft evidence-backed technical model documentation while preserving human validation and approval boundaries.
approval_boundaries: Do not claim model approval, validation, compliance, or production readiness.
Label unsupported claims and preserve qualified human review.

phases.name: Package context
phases.instructions: Inventory the documentation package, requested output, constraints, and missing evidence.

phases.name: Evidence analysis
phases.instructions: Trace every material claim to available package evidence or label it as a gap.

phases.name: Documentation draft
phases.instructions: Draft the requested technical documentation without overstating evidence.

phases.name: Independent documentation review
phases.instructions: Review traceability, clarity, internal consistency, and unsupported claims.

phases.name: Package validation
phases.instructions: Run available package validation or record manual validation requirements.

phases.name: Human-review handoff
phases.instructions: Produce a qualified-human review package with evidence gaps and next action.
